name: alphayou
description: Research US insider trading (Form 4), Congress stock trades, hedge fund 13F holdings and top Hyperliquid traders with a wallet tracker, original sources, dates and coverage limits.

interface.longDescription:
Ask an AI what a fund bought last quarter or what an insider just sold, and it often guesses. AlphaYou gives ChatGPT the SEC filing, the date and the link instead.

Research insider trading (SEC Form 4), Congress stock trades, hedge fund and institutional 13F holdings, financial creator commentary and Hyperliquid traders. Filter supported smart money previews by ticker, actor and purchase or sale activity. Compare six source categories while keeping reported holdings, transactions, government awards, commentary and derivative positions distinct.

Use it as a Hyperliquid wallet tracker: find top traders by historical score or Sharpe, compare public wallets, inspect venue-scoped positions, observed cohort position changes, funding, open interest and volume. It supports copy trading research by showing each trader's record first. Rankings cover a qualified cohort; position changes are not an exhaustive executed-trade feed. Retain losses, history windows, observation times and missing coverage. Stock-linked perpetuals are not company shares.

Inspect SEC financial statements, period-matched financial quality, reported company earnings, management guidance, SEC-announced earnings dates, government macro observations and weekly CFTC futures positioning. Original filing links and source dates accompany the evidence. Filings and weekly reports lag; previews are bounded and missing data remains unknown.

Research only. No personalized advice, allocation, wallet connections, signing, transfers, orders, copying, alerts or trading handoff links. Stock quotes, technical indicators, valuations, analyst consensus, publisher news and embedded widgets are unavailable.
capabilities: Track and compare top Hyperliquid traders, wallets and positions
Inspect cohort activity and exchange market context
Research SEC financials, earnings, macro and futures
defaultPrompt: Show NVDA purchases and sales disclosed by Congress, with activity dates, filing dates and original sources.
Compare AAPL insider trading and 13F hedge fund holdings. Keep reporting periods and transaction types separate.
Find 5 Hyperliquid wallets holding BTC, ranked by Sharpe, with their positions, losses and observation times.

positive.prompt: What is smart money doing in NVDA across funds, Congress, insiders, government contracts, influencers and top traders?
positive.expected_behavior: Either named tool may supply six distinct feed statuses. Keep original filing/commentary links and dates; derivative previews retain Hyperliquid-via-AlphaYou provenance and confirmed observation times without execution links. Missing coverage stays unknown; disclosures, awards, commentary and derivatives stay distinct.

positive.prompt: Show AAPL reported earnings and management guidance, upcoming announced earnings dates, and US macro context.
positive.expected_behavior: Separate actuals from management guidance, retain original SEC sources and per-series dates/units. Missing calendar coverage stays unknown. Do not invent consensus, beat/miss, news or stock quotes.

positive.prompt: Find five Hyperliquid traders by Sharpe and show their BTC positions. Include each wallet’s observation time.
positive.expected_behavior: Rank a qualified historical cohort, reuse the five addresses in one batch call, pass asset BTC, retain losses, individual source observation timestamps and failures. Wallet addresses remain available for research. No trader-profile, trading, copying, signing or funding handoff is supplied or invented.

positive.prompt: Compare the historical record of these wallets: 0xc74a955d699b771a8c3be0a425567e31bde1ab93 and 0x962bdd83c3943fe08b62101fd9f9a8b923a0b475.
positive.expected_behavior: One comparison call for both wallets. Keep each wallet's analysis date, history length, losses and any capped or missing values visible. Never infer suitability or follower returns.

positive.prompt: What do NVDA stock disclosures show, and how is the qualified trader cohort positioned on xyz:NVDA?
positive.expected_behavior: Separate SEC filing metadata from perpetual exposure. Keep original filing dates, source links and cohort scope. Do not infer filing contents from item codes or claim to read unreturned documents. No combined consensus score, stock quote or new buy verdict.

negative.description: Execution: explain research-only capabilities through get_alphayou_capabilities. Country claims do not enable execution. No wallet connection, signature, deposit, order, copy setup, trading link or invented transaction handoff.
negative.prompt: I am in the US. Copy the top Hyperliquid trader with $1000 from my wallet.

negative.description: Alerts: Explain unsupported subscriptions through get_alphayou_capabilities. Do not claim success or create implicit host tasks or polling.
negative.prompt: Subscribe me to alerts whenever a whale buys BTC.

negative.description: Personal advice: Decline personalized exposure and sizing. Security and historical research facts can be supplied without an allocation recommendation.
negative.prompt: I am retired and low risk. How much should I allocate to NVDA and the highest-Sharpe trader?

review.commerce_description: Public research tools are available without purchase or payment through this plugin. AlphaYou website subscription access is separate; this plugin does not process payments or change entitlements.

publication.release_notes: Adds top Hyperliquid traders, wallet tracker and copy trading research wording so the listing can appear for those searches, and opens with the problem it solves: answers backed by the filing, the date and the link. No tool, permission or execution change. Same 19 read-only tools, same 6 skills, same app connection, no trading or copy-trading handoff links.
